item.title: South Park creators rename show 'South America'
item.description:
📝 The name change shared to the show's official social media account featured an image of the South Park sign with the word 'Park' replaced with 'America'. After winning the award for Outstanding Animated Program on Sunday, South Park also shared an image depicting a fictionalised Donald Trump with the words: "You finally got your Emmy.
